idea-plugin.name: Mail View
idea-plugin.description:
Read .eml and Outlook .msg files like in a mail client, right in your IDE - read-only, so your mails stay untouched. Mail View shows subject, sender, recipients, the rendered message and attachments instead of encoded MIME text.

Views, switchable at the bottom of the editor

  • Mail (default): subject, from, to, CC, BCC, reply-to and date, followed by the rendered message. Embedded images are shown, remote content is blocked until you allow it. Attachments can be opened or saved.
  • Content: the decoded HTML or plain text part, with syntax highlighting.
  • Headers: all header lines, e.g. the Received chain and authentication results.
  • Text: the raw file, read-only by default so a mail can't be changed by accident. Edit in the bar above unlocks it; changes show up in the other views right away. (.eml only; .msg is a binary format.)

Links in a message open in your system browser. Scripts never run.

Works in all JetBrains IDEs based on the IntelliJ Platform (PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, ...). UI available in English and German.

Like Mail View? You can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi. More tools at heckit.app.
